import re

CTRL = re.compile(r'^(?P<controller>\S.*?) in Slot (?P<slot>\S+)(?:\s+\((?P<location>[^)]*)\))?(?:\s+\(sn: (?P<sn>[^)]+)\))?\s*$')
CAGE = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<name>.+?) at Port (?P<port>\S+), Box (?P<box>\d+), (?P<status>.+?)\s*$')
PORT = re.compile(r'^\s+Port Name: (?P<port>\S+)\s*$')
ARR = re.compile(r'^\s+Array (?P<name>\S+) \((?P<type>.+?), Unused Space: (?P<unused>.+?)\)\s*$')
UNAS = re.compile(r'^\s+Unassigned\s*$')
LD = re.compile(r'^\s+logicaldrive (?P<id>\S+) \((?P<size>[^,]+), RAID (?P<raid>[^,]+), (?P<status>[^)]+)\)\s*$')
PD = re.compile(r'^\s+physicaldrive (?P<id>\S+) \(port (?P<port>[^:]+):box (?P<box>[^:]+):bay (?P<bay>[^,]+), (?P<type>[^,]+), (?P<size>[^,]+), (?P<status>[^,)]+)(?:, (?P<role>[^)]+))?\)\s*$')
SEP = re.compile(r'^\s+SEP \(Vendor ID (?P<vendor>[^,]+), Model (?P<model>[^)]+)\)\s*(?P<device>\S+)?\s*(?:\(WWID: (?P<wwid>[^)]+)\))?\s*$')

def ns(s):
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', (s or '').strip())

def parse(lines):
    b = {}
    order = ['controllers', 'drive_cages', 'ports', 'arrays', 'logical_drives', 'physical_drives', 'enclosure_processors']
    for n in order:
        b[n] = {'name': n, 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    slot = ''
    arr = ''
    skip = []
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        m = CTRL.match(l)
        if m and not l.startswith(' '):
            slot = m.group('slot')
            arr = ''
            b['controllers']['lines'].append(i)
            b['controllers']['records'].append({'Controller': ns(m.group('controller')), 'Slot': slot, 'Location': ns(m.group('location')), 'Serial Number': ns(m.group('sn'))})
            continue
        m = PD.match(l)
        if m:
            b['physical_drives']['lines'].append(i)
            b['physical_drives']['records'].append({'Slot': slot, 'Array': arr, 'Drive': m.group('id'), 'Port': m.group('port'), 'Box': m.group('box'), 'Bay': m.group('bay'), 'Type': ns(m.group('type')), 'Size': ns(m.group('size')), 'Status': ns(m.group('status')), 'Role': ns(m.group('role'))})
            continue
        m = LD.match(l)
        if m:
            b['logical_drives']['lines'].append(i)
            b['logical_drives']['records'].append({'Slot': slot, 'Array': arr, 'Logical Drive': m.group('id'), 'Size': ns(m.group('size')), 'RAID': ns(m.group('raid')), 'Status': ns(m.group('status'))})
            continue
        m = ARR.match(l)
        if m:
            arr = m.group('name')
            b['arrays']['lines'].append(i)
            b['arrays']['records'].append({'Slot': slot, 'Array': arr, 'Type': ns(m.group('type')), 'Unused Space': ns(m.group('unused'))})
            continue
        if UNAS.match(l):
            arr = 'Unassigned'
            b['physical_drives']['lines'].append(i)
            continue
        m = PORT.match(l)
        if m:
            b['ports']['lines'].append(i)
            b['ports']['records'].append({'Slot': slot, 'Port Name': m.group('port')})
            continue
        m = CAGE.match(l)
        if m:
            b['drive_cages']['lines'].append(i)
            b['drive_cages']['records'].append({'Slot': slot, 'Drive Cage': ns(m.group('name')), 'Port': m.group('port'), 'Box': m.group('box'), 'Status': ns(m.group('status'))})
            continue
        m = SEP.match(l)
        if m:
            b['enclosure_processors']['lines'].append(i)
            b['enclosure_processors']['records'].append({'Slot': slot, 'Vendor ID': ns(m.group('vendor')), 'Model': ns(m.group('model')), 'Device': ns(m.group('device')), 'WWID': ns(m.group('wwid'))})
            continue
    out = [b[n] for n in order if b[n]['lines']]
    return {'blocks': out, 'skip': skip}
